 Mr. Dipankar Paramanick.

...for the S  1.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
2. We have considered the materials on record.
Petitioner No.1 is in custody for 120 days and petitioner No.2 is in custody for 113 days respectively.
They are not the principal accused.

Co-accused viz., Mriganka Sarkar @ Niganka Sarkar and Asit Sarkar @ Ashit Sarkar similarly circumstanced with the petitioner are on bail.
3.
Hence, we are inclined to extend the similar relief to the petitioners also.

4. Accordingly, the petitioners viz., Ratan Sarkar and Fatik Sarkar @ Pradip Sarkar shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- each with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Judge, Special Court under the POCSO Act,
Berhampore, Murshidabad subject to condition that they shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until Signed By : ALOK SETH High Court of Calcutta 18 th of April 2024 06:20:26 PM further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
